trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: The block-final sentence is 'The per-observable 100x accuracy target defines the empirical band for testing.' — a definition handing off to the next chapter, not a quotable flourish. The opening 'Substrate-level predictions assemble into a unified surface' is the closest thing to a rhetorical device in the block, but it introduces a seven-item list rather than closing anything, so it does not fire this criterion.
trap-closing-aphorism.notes: pass on all ten. Two notes for an author, neither a trap. (a) 'assemble into a unified surface' is an unexplained metaphor — the seven listed results are not shown to lie on any common surface, and the chapter does not use 'surface' as a term of art elsewhere; 'assemble into' alone would carry the sentence. (b) 'Setting $q_0 \approx 1.1100$ compares the predictions against CODATA, PDG, and SnapPy data' dangles its participle — the setting does not do the comparing. Proposed: 'At $q_0 \approx 1.1100$ the predictions are compared against ...'.
